PDF 转换：全部可用目标PDF conversions: every available target

本扩展把 PDF 当作两种东西看：有文字层的文档，或一叠页面图像。要文字时它只提取文字层，要样子时它把每一页渲染成图。没有 OCR，所以扫描件不会凭空长出文字；PDF 也没有表格结构，Excel、CSV 与 JSON 在界面上会被置灰。This extension treats a PDF as one of two things: a document with a text layer, or a stack of page images. When you want text it extracts the text layer; when you want the look it renders every page. There is no OCR, so a scan does not grow text, and a PDF carries no table structure, which is why Excel, CSV and JSON are greyed out.

界面上置灰的目标Targets the picker greys out

下面这些目标在路径图上可达，但语义上无效，工作台会把它们置灰并给出原因，而不是让你点下去得到一个空文件。These targets are reachable in the graph but semantically invalid, so the workbench greys them out with the same reason instead of letting you click through to an empty file.

  • Excel (.xlsx)：PDF 无法可靠转换为表格/结构化数据Excel (.xlsx): PDF cannot be reliably converted to tabular data
  • CSV：PDF 无法可靠转换为表格/结构化数据CSV: PDF cannot be reliably converted to tabular data
  • JSON：PDF 无法可靠转换为表格/结构化数据JSON: PDF cannot be reliably converted to tabular data

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 没有 OCR：只有页面图像、没有文字层的扫描件，文字类目标会得到空结果或直接失败No OCR: a scan with page images and no text layer gives text targets an empty result or a failure
  • PDF 没有表格结构，Excel、CSV、JSON 三个数据目标被 conversion-policy 置灰，界面上会给出原因A PDF has no table structure, so the Excel, CSV and JSON targets are greyed out by conversion-policy and the interface says why
  • 页面图片按 pdf.js 渲染；单次最多栅格化 200 页，超过时明确拒绝并建议先选页Pages are rendered by pdf.js; one conversion rasterises at most 200 pages and refuses past that, suggesting a page range first
  • 提取出的文字会重排：原始换行、分栏、表格网格与精确字号不保留Extracted text is reflowed: original line breaks, columns, table grids and exact type sizes do not survive

常见问题Questions people actually ask

扫描版 PDF 能转成 Word 吗？Can a scanned PDF become Word?

不能识别文字。扫描页是图像，没有文字层可提取，Word 里不会出现可编辑的句子。本扩展不捆绑 OCR；需要识别时请先用专门的 OCR 工具生成带文字层的 PDF。Not by reading it. A scanned page is an image with no text layer, so Word receives no editable sentences. This extension bundles no OCR; produce a text-layer PDF with a dedicated OCR tool first.

为什么 PDF 不能转 Excel？Why can a PDF not become Excel?

因为 PDF 描述的是页面上的线段与文字位置，不是行列数据。把视觉上的表格还原成真实单元格需要结构识别，这份工具不假装能做；目标会被置灰并说明「PDF 没有表格结构」。Because a PDF describes lines and text positions on a page, not rows and columns. Recovering a visual table into real cells needs structure recognition, which this tool does not pretend to do; the target is greyed out with “a PDF has no table structure”.

PDF 转图片会是可搜索的文字吗？Are PDF to image results searchable text?

不是。PNG、JPEG 与 WebP 都是像素，页面上的字变成图形。多页文档会打包成 ZIP，每页一张图；需要沿用的文字请走 TXT、HTML 或 Word 路线。No. PNG, JPEG and WebP are pixels, so the words become shapes. A multi-page document arrives as a ZIP with one image per page; when the text must stay usable, take the TXT, HTML or Word route.

能只转其中几页吗？Can I convert only some pages?

转图片时可以填写页码范围（如 2-5、8、11-13），解析按文档自称的页数进行；不填则整份处理。超过 200 页会拒绝，要求先缩小范围。For image targets you can give a page range such as 2-5, 8, 11-13, resolved against the document’s own page count. Leave it blank to process everything. Past 200 pages the conversion is refused and asks for a narrower range.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
